option_relations.rationale: Viral myocarditis is a distinct diagnosis and not directly related to ARDS with hemodynamic shock in a supertype/subtype or equivalent manner.
Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) is a distinct diagnosis and not directly related to ARDS with hemodynamic shock in a supertype/subtype or equivalent manner.
Bacterial sepsis with myocardial involvement is a distinct diagnosis and not directly related to ARDS with hemodynamic shock in a supertype/subtype or equivalent manner.

COVID-19 with cardiac injury and thrombocytopenia-associated multiple organ failure (TAMOF) is a distinct diagnosis and not directly related to ARDS with hemodynamic shock in a supertype/subtype or equivalent manner.
